text.en: Self-consistency is row 36 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: Self-consistency 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 36 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table associates Self-consistency with “Self-consistency improves chain of thought reasoning in language models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Self-consistency 与论文《Self-consistency improves chain of thought reasoning in language models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Xuezhi Wang, Denny Zhou”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Xuezhi Wang（官方页拼写）、Denny Zhou（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Xuezhi Wang, Denny Zhou”。
